description:
Facts control devices.

Most often used in AC power flow studies as a control of voltage and, active and reactive power.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type (e.g., `PowerLoad`) must have unique names, but components of different types (e.g., `PowerLoad` and `ACBus`) can have the same name.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`). Unavailable components are excluded during simulations.

control_mode.description: Control mode. Used to describe the behavior of the control device.
control_mode.descriptor: in psy5 a required param with an option to be nothing

voltage_setpoint.description: Voltage setpoint at the sending end bus in kV, it has to be a `PV` bus.

max_shunt_current.description: Maximum shunt current at the sending end bus; entered at unity voltage.

reactive_power_required.description: Total reactive power required to hold voltage at sending bus, as a percentage.

dynamic_injector.description: Corresponding dynamic injection model for FACTS control device.

title: FACTSControlDevice
